strings.en:
The first unit of the <Personal Trooper> R Series, developed
under the <SRX Project>. Its official name is REAL
PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-1.
A close-combat and melee unit with high mobility and
attack power. Its predecessors were the RTX-009
Hückebein 009 (plasma generator model) and the
PTX-006 Wildraubtier, and it inherits the strengths of
both.
Like the Wildraubtier, it can transform into a flight mode
(R-Wing). Thanks to that mobility, it often plays the
vanguard within the R Series, carrying out surprise
attacks, reconnaissance in force and the like.
To deal reliable damage, it carries solid-ammo weapons
for short to mid range. It also carries the <T-LINK System>,
letting it attack with the special force field the system
generates, the TK Field.

strings.en:
The second unit of the <Personal Trooper> R Series, developed
under the <SRX Project>. Its official name is REAL PERSONAL
TROOPER TYPE-2 POWERED.
A heavy Personal Trooper built for beam-based artillery
combat, it carries the <Tronium> Engine that powers the SRX.
Its firepower is high and its armor thick, but its unstable
engine output and low mobility are weaknesses. Within the R
Series, it handles suppressive fire and artillery support for
allies.
Fitted with plus parts such as the Hi-Zol Launcher heavy
metal particle cannon and shoulder armor, it becomes the
R-2 Powered.
When the SRX combines, the R-2's pilot adjusts the Tronium
Engine's output, handles damage control, and runs medical
checks on the R-1 and R-3 pilots. The R-2 has no
<T-LINK System>, so its pilot need not be a <Telekinetic>.

The third unit of the <Personal Trooper> R Series, developed
under the <SRX Project>. Its official name is REAL PERSONAL
TROOPER TYPE-3 POWERED.
A light Personal Trooper for command and long-range
combat, it features remote attack weapons based on the
<T-LINK System> and excellent target acquisition and data
gathering. Its pilot must be a <Telekinetic>, making it
effectively the personal unit of Captain Aya Kobayashi of the
<SRX Team>. Fitted with plus parts carrying the T-LINK Flight
System, it becomes the R-3 Powered, a heavy bomber form.

strings.en:
The first unit of the <Personal Trooper> RW Series, developed
under the <SRX Project>. Its official name is REAL PERSONAL
TROOPER TYPE-GUN POWERED.
Originally a high-output heavy metal particle cannon, it was
miniaturized for a certain purpose and given the ability to
transform into a Personal Trooper so it could move and fight
on its own.
It carries a new <Tronium> Engine with more output than the
R-2's, outdoing the other R Series units in output and
firepower, but its output is extremely unstable.
It is effectively the fourth R Series unit, but it was never
named R-4. Instead, it was developed in secret at
<Mao Industries> on the Moon under the code name ARGAN.
With plus parts such as the Hi-Twin Launcher mounted on its
back, it is called the R-GUN Powered. After the
<L5 Campaign>, the <T-LINK System> was improved, enabling
T-LINK Twin Contact with the R-3.

strings.en:
A prototype general-purpose, one-hit-kill <Personal Trooper>
developed under the <SRX Project>, made up of three units:
the R-1, R-2 Powered and R-3 Powered.
Its official name is SUPER ROBOT X-TYPE.
"A humanoid mobile weapon combining the traits of Super
Robots (special humanoid mobile weapons) and Personal
Troopers, able to change the course of a battle as one unit
or as three separate ones"... That was the development
concept given to the SRX.
In the SRX Project, the SRX was positioned as a separating
and combining mobile weapon: three standard-size
(20-meter class) Personal Troopers combine into a
50-meter-class Super Robot.
This let the SRX's combat power be used flexibly and
effectively by separating or combining as the situation
demands. Against many weak enemies, or when it must
coordinate with other Personal Troopers, it acts separated;
against a few strong enemies, it combines into the SRX to
concentrate the combat power of the R Series.
Its attack power is outstanding, but it has drawbacks: the
output of its <Tronium> Engine power source is hard to
regulate, and in combat the <T-LINK System> must constantly
project a TK Field to help hold the combination together
(placing a heavy strain on the T-LINK System's user). For
now, the number of combinations per sortie and its combat
time are limited.

strings.en:
ART-1 (Art One) stands for ADVANCED REAL PERSONAL
TROOPER TEST TYPE-1.
A new <Personal Trooper> built under the RXR Project, a
next-generation R Series development plan that is part of
the <ReEOTH Plan> to make <EOT> more reliable and stable.
It was developed experimentally from R-1 and Hückebein
Mk-III data to prepare for next-generation development
(being a prototype of a prototype, it wears test colors
rather than the R-1's tricolor scheme).
Only one exists. It can transform into a flight mode
(ART-Wing), but cannot combine with the other R Series
units. Even so, its performance surpasses the R-1.

strings.en:
A heavily upgraded version of the <Personal Trooper> Alteisen,
developed under the <ATX Project>.
Dr. Marion Radom built it based on input from its pilot,
Kyosuke Nanbu. It uses spare Weissritter parts and is armed
with the Revolver Bunker, which had been rejected for badly
upsetting the unit's balance; its other weapons were also
swapped for larger ones. It carries a <Tesla Drive> too, but this
is used for balance and charging power, so extended flight is
impossible. As a result, the Alteisen Riese gained firepower
and charging power unheard of for a Personal Trooper, but
became even harder to handle than the Alteisen. Even so,
Kyosuke has mastered it and achieved great results in many
battles.

strings.en:
The Rein Weissritter is the Weissritter transformed by the
mysterious bioweapons known as the <Einst>. Later analysis
suggests that Einst parts were not built in directly;
rather, the original parts were somehow altered. Its
mobility and artillery combat ability leapt dramatically, and
it can still fly alone under gravity as before. Its frame and
armor not only changed shape; the flexibility and elasticity
of their materials improved greatly, and they even gained
the ability to repair themselves. The biggest change is the
generator: the original plasma generator has become
something different, a kind of perpetual motion engine.
Many other parts have also become black boxes.

A bioweapon of the type called the <Einst> series, piloted by
Alchemie.
An Einst optimized for fighting <Personal Trooper> units, with
high mobility, strong defense, and the ability to warp
through space on its own. Its body consists of a skeleton and
skin that are both hard and flexible, plus soft,
muscle-fiber-like parts. Its main weapons are the Onirenge
(sword) for close combat and the Onibosatsu (demon-face
cannon) for long range, and it excels at tricky attacks

strings.en:
A mass-produced <Personal Trooper> developed from the
Hückebein Mk-II.
It was formally adopted as a new mainstay unit under the
Aegis Plan, the Earth Federation Army's arms buildup
program. It comes standard with a <Tesla Drive> and can fly
alone under gravity. It carries no <EOT> or EOT-based
weapons, but its basic performance nearly equals the
mass-production prototype's. It also uses an improved
version of the prototype's frame, the Gespenst-line GII
Frame, rather than the Hückebein-line H Frame, so its
production cost is low.

strings.en:
An MP Hückebein Mk-II modified by the 3rd Humanoid Mobile
Weapon Development Test Unit of the Earth Federation
Army Development Test Corps. Pfeil III (Drei) is a nickname;
its official name is MP Hückebein Mk-II MHRDT3 Custom. The
test unit uses it to build and try out update and future
modernization plans for the units used across Earth
Federation Army forces, then submits the ideas and data to
the manufacturer. Its <Tesla Drive> was strengthened and
vernier thrusters were added. Its head sensors were also
improved, giving it superior command and control capability.
At the wish of its pilot, Yon Gebana, technology from the
alien civilization <Zovorg> was cleverly camouflaged and built
in. In particular, its hand weapon, the Gun Stabblader
(combining the Switchblade Gun, a high-output energy
cannon for mid to long range, with the Sword Launcher, a
real-blade launcher for close combat), was modeled on the
weapons of a humanoid mobile weapon called the Greytarkin.

strings.en:
A super <Personal Trooper> developed under the EXH Project
of <Mao Industries>. A unit that delivers the greatest possible
attack power and versatility on its own... in other words, the
culmination of the standalone Hückebein line. It carries
ultra-high-output <EOT>-based generators, a Black Hole
Engine and a <Tronium> Engine, and incorporates a mechanism
(EXPS) for attaching weapon modules, extra armor,
boosters and other expansion and enhancement parts all over
the unit. It also carries the <T-LINK System> (a telekinesis
sensing and amplifying device), letting it use telekinetic
weapons for many purposes.
The name Exexbein comes from EX Exbein, but as the sixth
unit of the series, it also carries the meaning of Sechs
(German for "six").

strings.en:
A special humanoid mobile weapon for anti-alien combat,
developed by the <Tesla Reich Institute> at the request of
the Earth Sphere Defense Committee.
Its basic concept is physical attack through sheer mass,
and its size and shape were designed with psychological
effects on intelligent enemies (such as intimidation) in
mind.
Built to fight powerful enemy units that <Personal Trooper>
units cannot handle, it has extraordinary output and
attack power. Its dedicated weapon, the giant Type 0
Colossal Blade, is a ship-slaying sword that can cut
battleship-class objects in two.
Its back carries high-thrust boosters and trim balancers
for sword strikes, allowing free-ranging swordplay with
the Colossal Blade. Its joints use TGC Joints, which
control inertial mass with gravity control technology to
reduce load. After the <Inspector Incident>, it was refitted
and its power source changed to a plasma reactor.

strings.en:
The Grungust is a special humanoid mobile weapon
developed at the <Tesla Reich Institute> based on data from
the Grungust Type 0 and the PTX-007-02 Gespenst Mk-II
(Type S).
To perform well in many environments, it can transform
into a flight mode (Wing Gust) and a heavy tank mode
(Gust Lander). Its armor uses VG Alloy (Variable
Geometric Alloys), a type of active metal, allowing
transformations that largely ignore the structural and
shape limits of armor.
Its power source is a plasma reactor, and its joints use
TGC Joints, which control inertial mass with gravity
control technology to reduce load.
It also has built-in weapons such as the Boost Knuckle and
Final Beam, and excels in close combat. As piloting aids, it
carries a brainwave control device and a voice-activated
weapon selector.
Of the Grungust series, known for choosing their pilots, it
has the best overall balance, earning it the title of "Super
Fighter."
The Grungust Kai is an upgraded Grungust fitted with the
Roundel Wing booster and a Beam Cannon, improving its
mobility and attack power. Even with the Roundel Wing
attached, it can still transform into the Wing Gust (flight
mode) and Gust Lander (heavy tank mode).

Compared to its other form, KoRyuOh, it excels at aerial,
underwater and long-range sorcery combat, and has

A close-combat and melee unit inheriting the Alteisen's

It uses no <EOT> and carries solid-ammo weapons for short to

Purging its armor, called Jacket Armor, shifts it into
high-mobility mode. It was designed and developed by Dr.

A <Personal Trooper> developed by <Mao Industries>.
An artillery unit inheriting the Weissritter's concept. It
carries a high-performance <Tesla Drive>, giving it mobility
among the best of all Personal Troopers.
It is normally deployed with the close-combat Wildwürger,
and its combination attack with that unit in high-mobility
mode, the Twin Bird Strike, is especially powerful.
Its main weapon is the Oxtongue Rifle, which switches
between live rounds and energy shots. Unlike the Wildwürger,
it uses the Hückebein-line H Frame, making it more rigid and
lighter. It was developed by Dr. Kirk Hamill.
The name Wildfalken comes from the German words WILD
(wild) and WANDERFALKE (peregrine falcon). One other unit
of the same type exists.

strings.en:
The MP Gespenst Mk-II Sterben, nicknamed the Gestorben, is
a custom MP Gespenst Mk-II and a testbed for
<Daniel Instruments> to evaluate its own weapons and
expansion and enhancement parts. Refitted with versatility
in mind, it has hardpoints all over its body.
Serena Recital's unit is Gestorben No. 5 with further
improvements, called the Gestorben Custom. A major
change is the addition of a <Tesla Drive>, a high-efficiency
reactive propulsion device, which lets the Gestorben Custom
fly on its own, raising its versatility and mobility. Its joint
ranges were also reworked, allowing more flexible movement
than before.
Besides those refits, No. 5, given to Serena, has a melee
weapon suited to her fighting style (the Kylie Cleaver), and
its head sensors were enhanced for her main missions. Its
cockpit differs a little from other Gestorben Customs, with
a cradle for an autonomous <Sabot> (support robot) that
accompanies Serena and serves as her copilot.

and its Seeds Shield units were replaced with Seeds Anchor
units, improving its melee ability. An improved Gravicon
System also lets it deploy a G Territory, raising its defense
even further. The plan to rebuild it into the Duro (Italian for
"hard") was drawn up by Dr. Marion Radom. Its nickname is
the Gandoro.

strings.en:
Based on Dr. Marion Radom's plan, this is the Guarlion
Custom once piloted by Leona Garstein, lovingly upgraded
by her boyfriend, Tasuku Shinguji.
With the latest <Personal Trooper> technology and a
<Tesla Drive>, its mobility and attack power improved. It also
has the <T-LINK System> built in.
Like the Guarlion, it has extra force field inductors on both
shoulders. It fixes electromagnetically heated metal
particles at a point in front of the unit, wraps them in a TK
Field and extends them to strike the enemy.

A unit made by capturing the <DC>'s mass-produced
<Armored Module> Lion and strengthening its weapons and
armor.
Spare parts from <Personal Trooper> units such as the
Hückebein, Gespenst and Alteisen are used throughout. Its
arms in particular were swapped wholesale for Personal
Trooper arms, and folding slashing blades were fitted to its
legs, so it can handle the close and melee combat the Lion
was poor at. A makeshift conversion halfway between a
Personal Trooper and an Armored Module, but its potential is
high.

The combined form of the Altalion and Vegalion, the newest
of the Series 77 developed under the interstellar voyage plan
<Project TD>. Its mobility and maneuverability are the peak
among all <Armored Module> units, and it has tremendous

strings.en:
An <Armored Module> for space travel and space-environment
work, developed under the interstellar voyage plan
<Project TD>. The newest of the Series 77, it was designed
using data from its forerunner, the Astelion AX. With two
high-performance <Tesla Drive> units on its sides, its mobility
and maneuverability are unrivaled by other Armored Modules.
It can transform into the Cruise Figure (CF) for travel and
the Doll Figure (DF) for work, handling all sorts of situations.
Anticipating contact with hostile intelligent life in deep
space, it carries the gravity-controlled accelerator cannon
G-Axel Driver as its main weapon and the CTM series of
combined tactical missiles as secondary weapons.

A high-mobility <Armored Module> developed under the
interstellar voyage plan <Project TD>. The newest of the
Series 77, it was designed using data from its forerunner,
the Calion. With two compact, high-performance
<Tesla Drive> units, it boasts even greater mobility and
acceleration than its sister unit, the Altalion.

strings.en:
An <Armored Module> developed by the <Tesla Reich Institute> at
the request and with the funding of the Principality of
Riksent. Shine Hausen's personal unit.
Built by modifying and miniaturizing the Astelion's test
frame and <Tesla Drive>, it is lightened to the limit. As a result,
its mobility and maneuverability rival the Astelion's. It also
carries an <Energy Field> generator to make up for its fragile
armor, and a special man-machine interface called the
W-LINK System.
Type G's cockpit is specially built for Shine, who has
precognition, with a brainwave control device like the one in
the Grungust and a high-performance G Canceller.
The W-LINK System synchronizes the movements of the two
Fairlions to make up for the gap in piloting skill between
Latune and Shine. With it, Latune, in the Type S, can control
the Type G to a degree and perform combination attacks.

A high-mobility <Armored Module> developed by
<Isurugi Heavy Industries>, designed using data from the
Calion and Vegalion of the interstellar voyage plan
<Project TD>. Its performance rivals the Vegalion's, and the
Flexible Weapon Operators on both wings let it use the
firearms of Armored Module and <Personal Trooper> units. It
also has a large weapon bay with MTD guided missiles and a
folding TDA nose. It is easy to produce and maintain, and
while less versatile than the Relion, it is faster and has a

An updated model of the general-purpose air combat
fighter developed by <Isurugi Heavy Industries>.
As a next-generation unit for any battlefield, it offers
seamless air combat ability from low to high altitude and a
large payload. With flexible wings made of special
materials, a fully embedded cockpit, and a modular
structure with an extremely long TBO, it stands apart
from current units.

The first unit of the Dynamic General Guardian series,
nicknamed Double G: special humanoid mobile weapons for
defending the <Earth Cradle>, whose basic design was done by
<Dr. Bian Zoldark>, leader of the <DC> (<Divine Crusaders>). Built
for sword and melee combat, its controls use the DML
System and the dedicated OS JINKI-1, letting man and
machine move as one. Because it uses the ABMD (Artificial
Bone Muscle Drive) System to transmit power throughout its
body, it moves far more flexibly and dynamically than
humanoid mobile weapons of the same size.

The second unit of the Dynamic General Guardian series,
nicknamed Double G, whose basic design was done by
<Bian Zoldark>, leader of the <DC> (<Divine Crusaders>). Matched
to Rätsel's hit-and-run fighting style, it carries a
long-barreled beam cannon, high-output vernier thrusters,
and wheels for high-speed ground travel (Felse Rad). It can
also transform into Pferd Mode and carry the Dygenguar on
its back. Together, the two look like a mounted warrior,
overwhelming all who see them.

strings.en:
A captured and refitted Jinrai, the third Dynamic General
Guardian, developed from the blueprints of <Dr. Bian Zoldark>.
Its control AI, System ZLAI, was removed, making it a
manned unit with a DML (Direct Motion Link) System like Unit
1, the Dygenguar. It also incorporates System LIOH, a
groundbreaking man-machine interface. LIOH learns the
pilot's traits to draw out their latent ability, serving both as
the unit's control OS and as a pilot training system.
Its legs carry boosters developed as extra equipment for the
Dygenguar and Aussenseiter, and since its pilot, Touma, is
skilled in martial arts, it attacks mainly with kicks.

strings.en:
Prototype No. 9 of the TE Absorbers developed by the
Tsentr Project. It consists of a main body built from data
gathered with prototype No. 7, the Garmraid, and unmanned
mobile weapons called Machine Animalitos. It also carries a
new TE Engine, with better output and stability than the
Garmraid's. It can use an energy field called the TE Sphere as
well, raising its defense.
There are two kinds of Machine Animalitos: the Hiou, a
bird-type unmanned fighter, and the Louga, a wolf-type
unmanned mobile weapon. Each can operate alone, but they
are usually split into parts and attached to the Garmraid
Blaze's arms, legs, shoulders, back and so on.
The form with the Louga's head transformed into a striking
weapon on the right arm and the Hiou transformed into wing
boosters on the back is called Form G. Like the Garmraid, it
excels at melee combat.

strings.en:
The Compatible Kaiser combined with the large fighter
G-Thundergate. Its main engine, the OG (Over Gate)
Engine, was built with otherworldly over-technology: it
opens a limited hyperdimensional aperture and uses special
energy particles found in a weakly linked adjacent
subspace to drive the unit and power its attacks. It carries
systems similar to the ABMD (Artificial Bone Muscle Drive)
and DML (Direct Motion Link) Systems, letting man and
machine move as one. With the G-Thundergate
transformed into large wing boosters on the Compatible
Kaiser's back, its mobility and maneuverability improve,
and weapons such as the Shoulder Cannon are added.
Linking the OG Engines of the Compatible Kaiser and
G-Thundergate amplifies its output, enabling its ultimate
weapon, the Over Kaiser Sword. Nickname: the G-Compati
Kaiser.

strings.en:
A Super Robot piloted by Kota Azuma, a.k.a. Fighter Roar:
a humanoid mobile weapon entrusted to Kota's
grandfather Kisaburo by Roa, a warrior from another
world, then refitted. Its main engine, the OG (Over Gate)
Engine, was built with otherworldly over-technology: it
opens a limited hyperdimensional aperture and uses special
energy particles found in a weakly linked adjacent
subspace to drive the unit and power its attacks.
However, the OG Engine is not fully repaired, so for now it
cannot show its true power. It also carries systems similar
to the ABMD (Artificial Bone Muscle Drive) and DML
(Direct Motion Link) Systems, letting man and machine
move as one. It is also called the Compati Kaiser or the
Battle Force Robo.

strings.en:
A large fighter that serves as the Compatible Kaiser's
support mecha.
Like the Kaiser, it carries an OG (Over Gate) Engine and has
high mobility and attack power. Only someone wearing the
Emmy Armor can pilot it; no one else can.
It was thought destroyed in the past battle with <Dark Brain>,
but was recovered along with the Emmy Armor and repaired
as a weapon against the Compatible Kaiser. It was black at
first, but on combining with the Compatible Kaiser, it
returned to its original red.

strings.en:
A Super Robot that Dr. Kisaburo Azuma had been developing
at a certain company's request since before he met the
Compatible Kaiser. Its official name is Bankaran, but Michiru
Hanaten added a G in front, making it the G-Bankaran.
A power fighter skilled at melee, its heavy armor and sturdy
frame make it very durable. Know-how gained from the
Compatible Kaiser improved its joints, so it moves nimbly
despite its heavy build. Its looks are modeled on Kisaburo in
his youth, and he reportedly meant to climb in and fight
himself if it ever came to that.

strings.en:
A special humanoid mobile weapon for sword combat.
It carries the Direct Feedback System, which conveys the
pilot's thoughts straight to the unit, and is armed with
slashing weapons such as the Godaiken. Its cape is a kind of
shield that can even deflect beams.
Apparently developed alongside the Soulgain, it shares
common features with it in many parts. However, it lacks the
Direct Action Link System that lets man and machine move
as one. Its responsiveness and reaction speed fall a step
short of the Soulgain's, but its enhanced thrusters give it a
higher top speed.

strings.en:
A special humanoid mobile weapon for melee combat, piloted
by Axel Almer. The Direct Action Link System, which links
the pilot's movements to the unit, the Direct Feedback
System and the ABMD (Artificial Bone Muscle Drive) System
give it high responsiveness and mobility. Both elbows carry
melee blades made of a special liquid metal, used together
with its fists for superb melee ability. Most of the Soulgain's
armor is made of EG Alloy (an active metal specialized for
shape recovery), letting it repair battle damage to a degree.

strings.en:
A humanoid assault weapon in the category called Assault
Dragoons.
It carries a system that analyzes and records the pilot's
brainwave patterns, then semi-forcibly syncs with them
through feedback from the unit. With this, for patterned
operations, the pilot's reflexes are turned directly into
action commands.
Both shoulders carry Swordbreakers, remote-controlled
flying gun turrets, making it strong at mid to long-range
combat. This unit is a commander model, and several of the
same type exist.

strings.en:
A special humanoid mobile weapon piloted by Lamia
Loveless.
A mystical unit with almost organic wings on its back and a
design like a woman's suit of armor.
Its attacks, firing materialized energy shaped into spears
and arrows, and its slender rapier evoke a Western knight.
But much about its materials and power source is
unknown, and it very likely uses <EOT>.
It is said to have been developed by
<Isurugi Heavy Industries> for the <Federation Army>'s next
mainstay unit trials, but the truth is unknown.
Due to the unit's registration system, no one but its
exclusive pilot, Lamia, can operate it.

A humanoid mobile weapon for ground and artillery combat.
Also called the Type 34.
A custom unit made by transplanting a successor unit's drive
system and generator into the mass-produced RGV-Type 30
Randgriz, strengthening its artillery ability and armor. It has
thick armor and a shield, plus a Jammer and Beam Coat.
The Razangriff Raven is a modified Razangriff, fitted with a
flight unit that doubles as an armed base (carrying a
<Tesla Drive> and plasma generator).
It can now fly under gravity, and added weapons such as the
Particle Beam raise its attack power.

A humanoid mobile weapon for ground and artillery combat.
Also called the Type 30.
Its mobility is low, but its armor is thick and the unit is very
stable and reliable. It can also hover, giving it excellent
rough-terrain ability.
The Randgriz Raven is a modified Randgriz fitted with
booster pods carrying a <Tesla Drive>. Its linear cannons were
doubled to two, also raising its attack power.

strings.en:
A unit developed in the <Holy Kingdom of Langran> of the
subterranean world <La Gias>.
Blessed by the wind spirit Cyfis, it is known as the
<Masoukishin> of Wind. Its main power source is a
Fulcanelli-type perpetual motion engine. To raise its power
efficiency, it needs the <Prana> of its operator (pilot). Prana is
basically the same as what is called ki or aura, and the
operator supplies it. As a result, the unit's power depends
greatly on the operator's aptitude.
The unit is highly airtight and can operate underwater and in
space. An internal self-circulation system protects the
operator's bodily functions, allowing long operations. It also
uses ether (a massless energy at rest relative to absolute
coordinates) as a magical medium for propulsion.
Its armor is Orichalconium, with geometric patterns based on
talismanic numerology sealed in at the metal-particle level,
so its magical defense is high as well.
Its main computer is a Laplace Demon type that can
calculate causality and predict all kinds of events. However,
this function depends heavily on the operator's own magical
power.
Cybuster is not its true name, but a guardian name to ward
off magical attacks.
After the Sealing War, it lost the spirit's blessing in a battle
with the giants in La Gias. It now absorbs the malice drifting
in the boundary space of the <Cross Gate> with an Imitation
Ritual Converter and turns it into power. It performs almost
as well as before, but malice builds up in the unit, so its
operating time is greatly limited, and the malice must be
purified afterward.

Cybuster's cruise form.

<Holy Kingdom of Langran>.

The Valsione, second unit of the Valsion series, enhanced
with the alchemy of <La Gias>. The ABMD System transmits
power throughout the unit, and the DML System, which
traces the pilot's movements, handles control, allowing far
more flexible and human movement than any other humanoid
mobile weapon.

strings.en:
An anti-alien <Armored Module> piloted by Shu. Its power
source is an annihilation engine, and its armor is
ultra-resistant titanium reinforced at the elementary
particle level. It favors firepower, armor and defense over
mobility, and its attack power is fearsome. One of its
designers, Eric Wang, has said, "If its pilot had superhuman
abilities, the Granzon could wipe out the whole world's
military in a single day." It is also said that the <Kabbalah>
program Shu installed lets it use astral energy.

strings.en:
The anti-alien <Armored Module> Granzon, transformed after
unleashing its hidden power. Through the alchemy of the
subterranean world <La Gias> and the power of <Volkruss>, an
ancient evil god dwelling there, it has become an incarnation
of sheer terror.
The Granzon had many black boxes, and among them, what
its designers unanimously called "baffling" were the Riddles
placed throughout the unit. Shu installed them almost
single-handedly. They varied a little in size but were mostly
small enough to fit in a palm, posing no weight problem; yet
all were tied into a network, and no one but Shu understood
the system. The network was managed by a program Shu
installed called <Kabbalah> (Hebrew for "oral tradition"), and
was thought to give only small output boosts or strengthen
certain weapons during normal operation. Shu himself called
the network system Mahakala, and he reportedly mystified
those around him by asking whether it wasn't a fitting name
for a machine that commands black holes. Mahakala is
another name for Shiva, the god of destruction in Hindu
myth, and means "great black."
The tremendous attack power of its back-mounted Baryon
Creation Halo and Degeneration Cannon truly calls to mind
Shiva, the god of destruction Shu claimed to be.

A humanoid mobile weapon developed by the
Re-Technologists. A close-combat unit armed with the
Cypher Sword, which can both shoot and slash. Gravity
Boards attached to its legs let it move at high speed. It
carries the Res Arcana, a power source excavated from
ruins in Antarctica, and a man-machine interface called
the <Sympathia>.

The Aile Chevalier docked with the weapon box hanger
<Geant Aile>. This raises the output conversion efficiency of
the Aile Chevalier's Res Arcana, as well as its firepower and
mobility. Each booster unit has a fairly wide range of motion,
minimizing the loss of agility from the larger size. The Wired
Arm Controller connected to the Aile Chevalier operates the
Neo Cypher Sword and the Hyper Anchor Arm with its large
claw, letting it fight in melee despite its bulk. The Geant Aile
also has its own cockpit and can be used alone.

A humanoid mobile weapon developed by the
Re-Technologists, emphasizing aerial and ranged combat.
Besides the Vector Gun and Force Buster built into its
arms, it can have weapons (the Nan series) launched from
the Ars Nova, a large fighter that doubles as a weapon box
hanger, to swap out its arms. Like the Aile Chevalier, it
carries the <Sympathia> and the Res Arcana. The Blanche
Neige can also dock with the Ars Nova to fight, which not
only raises its attack power but also extends its range and
improves its mobility.

The Blanche Neige docked with the large weapon box hanger
Excelsio Ars Nova. This raises the output conversion
efficiency of the Blanche Neige's Res Arcana, as well as its
firepower and mobility. The Excelsio Ars Nova consists of
four weapon boxes, Ars Un, Ars Deux, Ars Trois and Ars
Quatre; it carries more weapons than the Geant Chevalier
but is less agile in close combat. It can fight in melee with the
large blade under its body, but it is basically a long-range
unit. It also has a launched defensive device called the
Passive Bit. The Excelsio Ars Nova also has its own cockpit
and can be used alone.

One of the NV Units, mobile weapons designed by the
Re-Technologists to fight extremely powerful units (of the
<Ruina>) and large numbers of enemies. It was meant to be a
special humanoid mobile weapon smaller than the <Geant Aile>
and Excelsio Ars Nova yet just as powerful, but production
was shelved due to cost and other problems. However, the
<Gaia Savers> obtained the blueprints, and it saw the light of
day along with the Geant Aile and Excelsio Ars Nova. It is
formed by two humanoid mobile weapons, the Ganadur and
Strega, transforming and combining, and running two Race
Arcanas in one unit gives it immense power. It can also
attack with the Ganadur's two variable multipurpose
weapons, the Figa.

A <Ruina> humanoid mobile weapon piloted by Glacies. Made by
transmuting materials on Earth with power granted by the
"King of Ruin," it has a power source similar to the Race
Arcana and a man-machine interface like the <Sympathia>.
Because it applies the knowledge of Ferio Radcliffe, who was
absorbed by the "King of Ruin," parts of its internal
structure resemble the Aile Chevalier and Blanche Neige.

eight-person rescue pod and small remote-controlled rescue

nominally meant for clearing obstacles. It carries a
<Tesla Drive>, allowing solo flight and high-speed movement in
high-mobility mode. Its comfortable cabin is fitted with

strings.en:
The second ship of the Space Noah-class multipurpose
battle carriers, built for anti-alien combat. It floats with a
<Tesla Drive> and is propelled by eight main rocket engines and
more.
Its hull is made of ultra-resistant metal, so it can not only
travel in space but also fly in the atmosphere and dive
underwater. It also excels at anti-ship artillery combat and
at carrying <Personal Trooper> units and fighters of all kinds,
making it the ship that realized the <Federation Army>'s ISA
tactic (Integrated Synchronizing Attack: a blitzkrieg by a
mobile battleship serving as a carrier and the humanoid
mobile weapons aboard it).
The Space Noah class was born of two opposite intentions,
an escort ship for an Earth exodus fleet and a battle carrier
with <PT> units for anti-alien warfare; as if to outwit the
overarching Earth exodus plan, it was given the combat
ability envisioned by the Earth Sphere defense concept.
To hide those dual intentions, it adopted a flexible structure
unheard of for a warship: a system that modularizes the ship,
using the hull and main engines as a common core, so that
combat modules for different purposes can be swapped in a
relatively short time.
The swappable part is the bow, and the first, second and
third ships each carry a different module.
The second ship Hagane's bow module is the Tronium Buster
Cannon, a high-output heavy metal particle cannon, giving it
attack power among the highest of any Federation Army
warship. Its code name is Steel 2.

strings.en:
A general-purpose battle carrier converted from the
Hiryu, humanity's first deep-space exploration ship.
It is also the first ship ever fitted with a <Tesla Drive>. In
<S.C.> 179, it was attacked by <Aerogators> mobile weapons
beyond Pluto's orbit and moderately damaged. After heavy
losses, it returned to Icarus Base in the asteroid belt.
It then underwent a major refit based on the ISA tactic
(Integrated Synchronizing Attack: a blitzkrieg by a mobile
battleship serving as a carrier and the humanoid mobile
weapons aboard it), and was reborn as the
general-purpose battle carrier Hiryu Custom.
Its bow carries a super gravity impact cannon based on
<EOT>, giving it combat ability second only to the Hagane
and Kurogane. Its code name is Dragon 2.

strings.en:
The Galilnagant is a High Personal Trooper used by the
<Gaia Savers>, a special unit formed after the <Shura Revolt>
ended.
But that is only its public face; it came neither from
<Mao Industries> nor from the <SRX Project>. It is not even of
Earth origin: it is one of the Hum Zelem series of mobile
weapons developed by the alien civilization of the
<Ze Balmary Empire>. Its power source, the <Tronium> Rev, can be
called the original or superior version of the Tronium Engine
carried by the SRX and others; it is highly reliable and stable,
and its output is easy to control. The Galilnagant also carries
Merafty Deen, a system that applies a kind of numerology
(gematria) to open a gate linking this world (the material
realm) and a higher realm and draw energy from it. Its ultimate
aim is to draw Or (light) from Ein Sof (the infinite), but it is
still at the research prototype stage, and for now it produces
only the tiniest fraction of that power.

<Gaia Savers>. It was developed from data on a captured Rest
Gemira, an unmanned general-purpose transformable mobile
weapon used by the <Inspectors> (Earth code name: Geminira).
It makes the most of the Rest Gemira's flexible structure
and wide-ranging joints, giving it high mobility and
responsiveness. It also carries a high-performance
<Tesla Drive>. To keep production costs down, the
transformation mechanism was omitted.
The time from the Rest Gemira's first sighting on Earth to
the Canis's mass production was short, likely because Arteur
(<Euzeth>) had somehow obtained the unit's data, or an actual
unit, in advance and begun development early.

<United Colony Corps> in the <DC War>. After the war,
<Isurugi Heavy Industries> kept producing it, and it is used not
only by DC remnants but also by the Earth Federation Army
(Federation model number RAM-006).
Designed on the premise of fighting humanoid mobile weapons,
it is a highly versatile, high-performance unit that, together
with its improved bullet resistance, can also handle regional
warfare.
Used as a commander's Armored Module, it serves as a fast
battlefield control unit that keeps pace with main formations
of Lions. It carries the high-efficiency reactive propulsion
device <Tesla Drive>, which can separate gravitational and
inertial mass, and uses the T-Dot Array as a repulsion and
inertial mass control field that serves as the unit's "shield."
It also fixes a weakness noted in the two earlier models (the
Lion and Barrelion), the lack of weapon options; along with the
evolution of limb control via the LIEON System, it can use
many weapons, starting with melee blades.
There is also a cheaper type with some features, such as
command and control functions, omitted.

A mass-produced <Armored Module> used by the <DC> and the
<United Colony Corps> in the <DC War>. After the war,
<Isurugi Heavy Industries> kept producing it, and it is used not
only by DC remnants but also by the Earth Federation Army
(Federation model number RAM-004V). An improved Lion with
enhanced mobility.
The high-efficiency reactive propulsion device <Tesla Drive>,
which can separate gravitational and inertial mass, reduces
only its gravitational mass; small downward jets let it float
easily, and the lift of its small main wings keeps it flying. Its
thrust comes from a separate device, however: a large
conventional engine is built in as the main engine in its unusual
lower body, which doubles as landing gear. The lower body also
has many attitude control thrusters that allow bold terrain
following, so it can handle surface combat as well. Swapping
some parts also lets it operate in space. It has an extremely
simple structure for a Tesla Drive unit, and its production
cost is low.
Even after the DC War, Isurugi Heavy Industries kept
producing it, and the Earth Federation Army uses it as a
mainstay unit.

Lion Type L; Landlion is a nickname.

place of legs, giving it excellent rough-terrain ability.
Setting the Stick Movers nearly horizontal also lets it lower

Its mobility and maneuverability are inferior to the Lion's, so
it is basically used to attack and defend ground bases. For
that role, it carries a large Railgun with better performance
than the normal type's. It can fly alone with its <Tesla Drive>,
but is ill-suited to aerial combat.

its own but also fly alone with its <Tesla Drive>. Its external

giving it a sturdy body with minimal structural material. As a
result, everything but the essential modules is fairly simple in
structure, making it easy to maintain and keeping its cost
within mass-producible range.

mobility and maneuverability), bringing everything together

strings.en:
A variant of the Gyanonia, a type of Arounzer, the wide-area
attack mobile weapons designed by Herluga Izberga. Its pilot
is Reggiane Josephine.
To explore the Gyanonia's expandability, it was tuned for
high-mobility melee rather than one-against-many shooting.

thrusters let it fight in the air under gravity too. Shifting to
high-mobility mode unfolds its folded legs, raising its
mobility even further. Mastering this mode takes skill on par
with top aces like Reggiane and Vort.

the Fury creator god Fureim (that is, the head of the
imperial family), together with one of the Shune bloodline,

durability are all improved. Its greatest feature is the
Brigandi System, the coordinated operation of the
Bellzelute body and the Buster Armor: the latter can be
detached and transformed into Double B Form, letting the
unit flexibly change its method of attack to suit all kinds
of situations and targets.

Dracodeus, and the very best of Fury technology went into it
to stop the "King of Ruin" from manifesting. High-output

four limbs, and it carries a great sword called the Orgo-La
Vodo. Its cockpit, including the Cytron System, and its
Larseilam were transplanted from Gu-Landon's Raftclans
(that unit was dismantled, and most of its parts were built
into the Zee-Gadin).
Gu-Landon, resolved to become the Fury's new emperor,
gave this unit another name: the Emperor Unit.

strings.en:
The Transfigured God Ship Grandred Fenossa, which fought
fierce battles with the <Dark Brain> Army in the past, was said
to house the soul of the god who gave power and wisdom to
Roa's race. It was an object called the Divine Body,
unearthed by Roa's ancestors; because it held powerful
energy, it was built into the Grandred Fenossa as the power
source of its weapons (which is apparently why it was called
a Transfigured God Ship).
The Divine Body was in truth Kadum Hakam, king of the
giants, who appeared through the <Cross Gate> in lands
inhabited by intelligent life, granted them wisdom and then
ruled them. It had long lain dormant, but awoke after the
Grandred Fenossa was forced into the Cross Gate in its
fierce battle with Skull Knight and the others. Calling itself
XN-L, it began to act on its own.
The Grandred Fenossa's form differs from before in its
details; it seems XN-L somehow transformed it, its own
form included, when it awoke (the Divine Body's
transformation and XN-L's true body were things even Roa
had never seen).
